decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Greasefang and Parhelion II to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck focuses on controlling the game with removal and disruption spells like Bitter Triumph and Thoughtseize, while also including cards like Esika's Chariot and Thundering Broodwagon to provide additional threats and support for the combo pieces. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing the various cards in the deck, the player aims to create a strong board state and secure victory through overwhelming pressure and synergy.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to utilize a combination of spells and abilities to control the opponent's board while generating card advantage. The deck focuses on bouncing opposing threats, countering spells, and drawing cards through cards like Divide by Zero, Combustion Technique, Pop Quiz, and Tablet of Discovery. It also includes powerful finishers like Thor, God of Thunder to close out the game. The deck aims to control the game tempo and outvalue the opponent through efficient spell usage and card draw.

This deck is focused on efficiently controlling the game by disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, while also removing threats with cards like Abrupt Decay and Fatal Push. It also utilizes graveyard interaction with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and finish the game with powerful threats like Sentinel of the Nameless City. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth mana production and consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy using cheap, efficient spells and creatures to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Emberheart Challenger to apply pressure early on, while also packing removal spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to clear the way for attacks. The deck also includes cards like Stormchaser's Talent and Flow State to provide additional reach and help close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using efficient creatures with low mana costs. The deck focuses on generating early mana advantage with cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves to quickly deploy threats like Badgermole Cub and Botanical Brawler. Skyclave Apparition provides removal and disruption while cards like Jennifer Walters and Surrak, Elusive Hunter offer powerful late-game options. The mana base is designed to support a consistent curve and ensure the deck can operate smoothly throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of removal spells, efficient creatures, and land disruption to control the game and outvalue opponents. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while deploying threats like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Tear Asunder also provides additional utility and resilience against certain strategies. With a mix of control elements and powerful threats, this deck aims to grind out games and secure victory through attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively control the board with low-cost creatures and removal spells, while also utilizing instant and sorcery spells for additional damage and card advantage. By efficiently playing creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage alongside spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain board control throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Stormchaser's Talent and Experimental Synthesizer allows for flexibility in handling threats and adapting to different game situations.

The deck focuses on using control elements such as counterspells, removal, and card draw to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. It includes a variety of versatile spells like Change the Equation and Get Lost to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having win conditions like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and March of Otherworldly Light. The deck aims to delay the opponent's actions, gradually gaining advantage and eventually overwhelming them with powerful spells and card advantage to secure the victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, and removal spells. It aims to maintain card advantage and tempo by utilizing cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Cryogen Relic. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional flexibility and value by flickering permanents for extra triggers. The mana base is optimized for consistency and to support the deck's game plan of outlasting the opponent and eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also gaining advantage with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Graveyard Trespasser. The deck also utilizes a land package to ensure consistent mana production and includes cards like Emeritus of Abundance to generate value. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient removal spells and resilient threats to secure victory in a one-on-one format.

This deck focuses on using powerful creatures and spells to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay, along with hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The creatures in the deck, such as Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, provide additional threats and card advantage. The land base includes options for both mana fixing and utility lands like Mutavault and Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy game.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly by using cards like Lotus Field and Vizier of Tumbling Sands. The goal is to cast powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to overwhelm the opponent in a single turn. Strict Proctor and Spara's Headquarters help control the board while cards like Hidden Strings and Pore Over the Pages provide card advantage. The deck also includes a toolbox of cards like Mastermind's Acquisition and Fae of Wishes to search for specific answers or win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to assemble key pieces for a game-winning combo setup.

This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo by using cards like Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II. It includes various control elements such as Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also features mana ramp with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Esika's Chariot to help cast the combo pieces faster. Additionally, there are synergy cards like Witherbloom Command and Formidable Speaker to support the theme of the deck. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful synergies.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a graveyard-based combo strategy to quickly generate a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Narcomoeba, Bloodghast, and Prized Amalgam, along with spells like Practiced Offense and Witherbloom Command, the deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard and bring back recurring threats to attack the opponent. Other key components include cards like Creeping Chill and Founding the Third Path to further support the graveyard strategy and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. By using cards like Accumulate Wisdom and Jeskai Revelation to draw extra cards and generate value, as well as Combustion Technique and Divide by Zero to deal with threats, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful finishers like Thor, God of Thunder and Gran-Gran provides a win condition to close out the game once the opponent has been sufficiently controlled.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. It utilizes efficient creatures like Marauding Mako and Vivi Ornitier, along with powerful spells like Fear of Missing Out and Dig Through Time. Quantum Riddler and Jadzi, Steward of Fate provide additional utility and card advantage. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Profit's Eidetic Memory help maintain momentum and disrupt opponents. Winternight Stories and Into the Flood Maw provide additional card selection and disruption. Torch the Tower and Lightning Axe serve as removal options to clear the way for attacking creatures.
